headline: Bayer Shares Jump 5% After Q3 Beat Prompts 2026 Forecast Upgrade
summary: Bayer shares jumped 5% after reporting a third-quarter earnings beat that prompted the company to upgrade its full-year 2026 forecast.
why: Positive earnings surprises and upward guidance revisions signal operational outperformance, boosting investor confidence.

impacts.name: Bayer AG
impacts.why: A third-quarter earnings beat and an upgraded 2026 forecast directly increase the fundamental valuation of the stock.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: An unexpected third-quarter beat and raised annual guidance drove institutional buying and short-covering in Bayer shares.
